# Biomarker transport study

## Abstract

We evaluated a transportable biomarker model in 84 adult participants.

## Introduction

Prior work reported a related association [1, 2]. A later synthesis reached a narrower conclusion (Nolan et al., 2024).

## Methods

Participants provided informed consent before enrollment. The analysis used a locked software environment and an independently held test set.
